reviews.t: Works as advertised--Final look is on the technician
reviews.x: Super easy.  Takes longer than gel application but having stronger nails is worth it.  This product seems to allow your nails to breathe.  The final coat is hard to with and the brush will get hard quickly.  You must work fast.  There is an unexpected warming sensation when applied.

I purchased this set after having about 10 dip powder manicures at my salon. I have been an avid gel polish user for more than 5 years and have done gel polish at home other than the occasional manicure. I moved to dip powder because of the benefits {no UV exposure; nails don't curl; less lifting and peeling}. After seeing how easy the dip powder process is to complete {and considering the expense every 2-3 weeks} I decided to try this process at home. I purchased color D71 {Flawless Pink} and i

Product came super fast! I was slightly disappointed at first because Amazon said it would arrive in 4 weeks. It actually arrived in what seemed like 3-4 days! Totally surprised! I recommend getting a professional nail file with an 80/100 grit to help shape nails. Some of the nail stuff do smell strong & the #4 nail finish may very well be super glue. Be careful with #4 on your skin/clothes. Otherwise lasting longer than the salon. Can't wait to buy more.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the product as easy to apply and comparable to salon-quality results.
Many note a learning curve, saying results improve with practice and that first attempts may be imperfect.
Several reviewers praise the durability and longevity of the manicure, with some saying it lasts weeks.
A few reviewers mention strong odor and difficulty removing the product, comparing it to gel or Shellac.
Some reviewers note that online color photos are misleading and recommend checking real-life images.
